# ReadMe format guidelines

## Language guidelines

Use only the Italian language, except for keywords and technical concept which are best explained in English.

## Format

Follow the same format used for the other sections of the readMe.
Create a section explaining what's the logic used for the main purpose of the file.
DON'T dive too much into technical details, it's important to explain the logic, the finality and how to use it.
